question: The last article of the Constitution of India has been given the number _______. (as on May 2022).
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Constitution of India** has **395 articles **contained in **22 parts.**
 
• It also has **12 schedules**.
 
• Since its adoption in **26 November, 1949,** the constitution has been amended for about **103 times.**
 
• The total number of Amendment Bills that have been introduced till now in parliament is **126.**
